biography.plain_text: Elizabeth (Liz) Leadbetter built a business career with her husband Shane in Australian manufacturing before moving into Queensland property development. The pair led automotive-accessory maker East Coast Bullbars for more than two decades. Their later development portfolio spans luxury homes, apartments and industrial properties, with Elizabeth named as an active partner in the enterprise.

The pair led automotive-accessory maker East Coast Bullbars for more than two decades. confidence.reason: Official developer account directly supports the joint manufacturing-to-property career and portfolio; independent builder coverage corroborates project participation.

long_biography.plain_text:
The Leadbetters' first sustained venture was East Coast Bullbars. Its Queensland-made vehicle equipment became known beyond Australia while Shane and Liz directed the firm over a 26-year period. Their own account dates the start of their manufacturing success to 1981. It does not disclose how the venture was initially financed or divide its ownership between the two. This industrial background preceded a move into developing and holding property.

Under Leadbetter Property Developments, the couple assembled sites and completed a range of buildings, including coastal residences, smaller apartment schemes and commercial premises. Liz joined Shane at the signing for Sea Pearl on the Sunshine Coast, a major residential commission handled by Hutchinson Builders. The company presents design quality, careful choice of location and attention to clients as the threads connecting its projects. Shane holds the managing-director title, while Liz is expressly included in its history of both ventures. A 2022 interview describes the couple as running an investment business.
